description: Evaluation cases for the Lost & Found agent. Run against the corpus seeded by scripts/seed.py. expected_decision is one of: matched | escalated | no_match.

cases.query: I lost a black Sony headphone near the library yesterday
cases.note: Strong match: brand + color + type + location all agree with a seeded found report.

cases.query: I lost my brown leather wallet somewhere around the parking lot
cases.note: Strong match: distinctive item, color and location agree.

cases.query: I lost a silver laptop charger in one of the lecture halls
cases.note: Match to the silver MacBook charger in lecture hall B.

cases.query: I think I lost some black electronics somewhere on campus
cases.note: Ambiguous: vague item type, only color agrees; should be flagged for review.

cases.query: I lost a pair of white wireless earphones
cases.note: Near-neighbour: white Apple earbuds exist but item wording and brand differ.

cases.query: I lost my red bicycle near the sports complex
cases.note: No similar item in the corpus; confidence should fall below the low threshold.
